Reference image for [[Jokes#Mournful_Roar|Jokes]] on [[Mournful Roar]]: the start of entry 839, "Lamentation", in an 1879 American edition of Peter Mark Roget's ''Thesaurus of English Words and Phrases'', page 350. The entry lists words with the same meaning side by side.
